name: Ray-cast Occlusion with Sampling Masks
definition: An optimized occlusion calculation method that uses pre-generated sampling masks (idx_add and idx_remove) to efficiently update occlusion values along a ray direction, rather than re-sampling the entire sphere for each voxel.
summary: Ray-cast Occlusion with Sampling Masks accelerates volume rendering by using pre-computed masks to incrementally update occlusion values along a ray, avoiding full sphere re-sampling for each voxel.
